triples.evidence_text: In below freezing conditions, drain the pump to prevent damage from freezing.

triples.head_surface: remaining liquid that could freeze the pump rotating parts
triples.head_canonical_zh: 可能导致泵转动部件冻结的残留液体
triples.tail_surface: Operate the pump for approximately one minute
triples.evidence_text: Operate the pump for approximately one minute; this will remove any remaining liquid that could freeze the pump rotating parts.

triples.head_surface: large solids from clogging the drain port and preventing the pump from completely draining
triples.head_canonical_zh: 大颗粒固体堵塞排放口并阻碍泵完全排空
triples.tail_surface: insert a rod or stiff wire in the drain port, and agitate the liquid during the draining process
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在排放口插入杆或硬丝并在排放过程中搅动液体
triples.evidence_text: To prevent large solids from clogging the drain port and preventing the pump from completely draining, insert a rod or stiff wire in the drain port, and agitate the liquid during the draining process.

triples.tail_surface: placing a contact-type thermometer against the housing
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 将接触式温度计置于壳体上测量
triples.evidence_text: Bearing temperatures can be measured accurately by placing a contact-type thermometer against the housing.

triples.tail_surface: bearings are at the point of failing to operate properly
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 轴承即将失效无法正常运转
triples.evidence_text: A sudden increase in bearing temperature is a warning that the bearings are at the point of failing to operate properly.

triples.tail_canonical_zh: 轴不对中和/或过度振动
triples.evidence_text: Bearing overheating can also be caused by shaft misalignment and/or excessive vibration.

triples.head_surface: oil level in the seal and bearing cavities
triples.tail_surface: check the oil level in the seal and bearing cavities before initial startup, after the first two weeks of operation, and every month thereafter
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 初次启动前、运行两周后及此后每月检查密封腔和轴承腔油位
triples.evidence_text: On a new pump, check the oil level in the seal and bearing cavities before initial startup, after the first two weeks of operation, and every month thereafter.

triples.tail_surface: clean the area around the plug
triples.evidence_text: Before installing or removing the lubrication plug, always clean the area around the plug to prevent contamination.

triples.tail_surface: supply fresh lubricating liquid from an external source
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 从外部源供应新鲜润滑液
triples.evidence_text: When handling abrasive or tacky liquids, supply fresh lubricating liquid from an external source.

triples.tail_surface: fill the seal cavity with SAE No. 30 non-detergent oil
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 向密封腔加注SAE 30号非洗涤剂机油
triples.evidence_text: Before starting the pump, remove the vented plug and fill the seal cavity with SAE No. 30 non-detergent oil.

triples.tail_surface: Fill the automatic grease cup through the grease fitting with No. 2 lithium base grease until grease escapes from the relief hole
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 通过注脂嘴向自动油脂杯加注2号锂基脂直至油脂从泄油孔溢出
triples.evidence_text: Fill the automatic grease cup through the grease fitting with No. 2 lithium base grease until grease escapes from the relief hole.
